rules.rationale: The rule is the reusable form of the complete loop transition proved as claim [prod-signs-loop] in loop-connection-spec.k. In prove.sh, LOOP-CONNECTION is compiled from loop-connection.k, whose import chain contains VERIFICATION-BASE but not VERIFICATION or this rule; kprove establishes the matching claim before verification.k is compiled, and the Stage 1 proof record reports #Top with exit 0. The claim and rule have the same loop body, continuation, result, bindings, scope changes, heap preservation, call-frame removal, return/exception states, and exit state; priority(30) only controls later rule application.
